verdict.rationale: Typesense is documented as 'typo-tolerant search engine' out-of-the-box, and docs include a dedicated 'Tuning Typo Tolerance' section for controlling fuzzy matching behavior, plus community feedback praising built-in fuzzy text matching. missing for 10: no independent benchmark of typo-tolerance accuracy/edge-cases and no detail in evidence on exact configurable parameters (num_typos, per-field settings) beyond the section title.
